books.head: Ledger backup
books.locksValue: Invoices and memos, receipts and address book on this network
books.keyFromValue: A second key from your PayLink key: not the one that signs, never stored
books.note: Only this passkey opens the file, on any device it syncs to. PayLink keeps no copy.
books.signIn: Use your PayLink key to back up or restore this ledger.
books.status.fingerprint: Confirm with your fingerprint: it opens the ledger key, not your account.
books.saved.one: Backup saved: {count} record, encrypted for your passkey.
books.saved.other: Backup saved: {count} records, encrypted for your passkey.
books.status.unlocking: Confirm with your fingerprint to unlock the file…
books.skipped.one: {count} record failed the checks and was left out.
books.skipped.other: {count} records failed the checks and were left out.
books.error.unreadable: Not a PayLink ledger backup, or a damaged one.
books.error.tooLarge: Too large to be a PayLink ledger backup.
books.error.newer: A newer PayLink made this backup: reload the page and try again.
books.error.wrongKey: Not made with your passkey: the backup stays locked.
books.error.tampered: The backup failed its integrity check: it was changed after it was made. Nothing was restored.
books.error.otherAccount: This backup holds another account's ledger ({address}). Use the PayLink key that made it.
books.error.otherNetwork: This backup is for a network this edition does not serve ({chain}).
books.error.empty: This ledger is empty: nothing to back up yet.
